Patch Set 34:

(9 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The main one is the length validation in gssiam_downcall_store(), which can be defeated with a wrapped idd_principal_len and then writes far outside the allocation. Also, this adds three new user-visible tunables plus a new installed binary with no test coverage - could a sanity-sec (or new sanity-gssiam) case exercise the upcall/downcall/flush round trip?

commit.subject: LU-19921 ptlrpc: add GSSIAM upcall operations and helper
commit.message:
LU-19921 ptlrpc: add GSSIAM upcall operations and helper

This patch adds the upcall operations and tunable attributes
for the GSSIAM security flavor, along with the userspace helper
script (l_gssiam_upcall) which retrieves the user's enterprise
GSSIAM token and passes it back to the kernel via a sysfs downcall.

Signed-off-by: Di Wang <ddiwang@google.com>
